items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: In fact, we worked together on several different occasions.

ctx.x: Yeah, because of the bands in that period were using the sousaphone for the bass, to play the bass parts. But he had been playing...long before I was born playing the bass violin. So he had to be early in the Jazz thing. In fact, we worked together on several different occasions.
